sources.title: Chamel et al. (2021/2023), Electron Captures and Stability of White Dwarfs
sources.anchor: Sections 2-4; equations 6-17, 31-39. Authors' analytical results, with stated cold single-species approximations.

sources.title: Martinez-Rodriguez et al. (2016), Neutronization During Carbon Simmering In Type Ia Supernova Progenitors
sources.anchor: Abstract. MESA evolution, weak reactions, neutron excess and metallicity. Full model not reproduced.

sources.title: Piro and Bildsten (2008), Neutronization During Type Ia Supernova Simmering
sources.anchor: Abstract. Weak reactions, carbon burned and convective Urca; compared with the later L02.

sources.title: Timmes, Brown and Truran (2003), On Variations in the Peak Luminosity of Type Ia Supernovae
sources.anchor: Abstract. Conditional relation between electron fraction, metallicity and Ni56 yield; no universal luminosity-mass law.

sources.title: Katz, Kushnir and Dong (2013), An exact integral relation between the Ni56 mass and the bolometric light curve of a type Ia supernova
sources.anchor: Abstract with derivation of the time-weighted energy integral and its three assumptions.

sources.title: Wygoda, Elbaz and Katz (2019), Type Ia supernovae have two physical width-luminosity relations... I. Bolometric
sources.anchor: Sections 2.1, 2.3, 3.3 and 6: flux ratios, gamma escape time, systematics and non-unique ejecta mass.

sources.title: Erler and Ramsey-Musolf (2005/2007), Weak mixing angle at low energies
sources.anchor: Introduction equations 1-5 and RGE/matching sections: separate gauge couplings, scheme, scale and physical amplitudes.

sources.title: Drummond and Hathrell (1980), QED vacuum polarization in a background gravitational field and its effect on the velocity of photons
sources.anchor: Publisher abstract: QED one-loop curvature-induced photon propagation. Full PDF not custodied.
